title: Patch: a Unit revealed from Cloaked is summoning sick on its reveal turn
thread:
**Issue #4237 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4237: Patch: a Unit revealed from Cloaked is summoning sick on its reveal turn
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Today a Unit set face-down by its Cloaked keeps the turn it was set as its `summonedTurn`. If it is revealed on a later turn (Activate: Reveal), it can attack straight away. [R783006] and [R1041] call this "the one exception to [R83] and [R171]". So a player can set a Cloaked Unit, pass, and reveal it next turn as an unexpected Charge-like attacker.

This patch removes that exception. A Unit revealed from Cloaked **enters the field on the turn it is revealed** and is summoning sick for the rest of that turn, like any Unit that enters a unit zone ([§4.1], [R83], [R171], and [§3] Animated: "Entering the unit zone is entering it on that turn"). Rush and Charge lift the sickness as usual: Rush for enemy Units only, Charge for Units and the hero. Switching to Defense stays allowed, as for any sick Unit.

Not affected:
- A revealed **Spell** or **Field Spell** (they do not attack).
- Everything else about the reveal: the `animated` event (never `summoned`, [R445]), the Cry running with prompts, Crater's lock ([R783010]), the reveal being a firing ([R783006]), and its being offered only while the card can come out whole.

Where it lives:
- `crates/engine/src/alt_play.rs`, `reveal_effect`. The block commented `R1041, R171` stamps `summoned_turn` with `max(set_turn, summoned_turn)`. It should stamp the current turn instead, the turn the card animates into its unit zone.
- Spec text to change:
  - `spec/06-keywords.md`, the Cloaked row: "a Unit animates into a unit zone (it may attack on a later turn)".
  - `spec/rulings/R783006.md` and `spec/rulings/R1041.md`: the "keeps the turn it was set as its `summonedTurn`" sentences.
  - `spec/04-combat.md` §4.1's summoning-sickness paragraph, if it needs the case named.
- The AI (`crates/ai`): if anything values a set Cloaked Unit, or its Reveal, as an attacker this turn (the move order, `reply.rs`, the lethal solver), it must now see a revealed Unit as sick unless it has Rush or Charge. The engine's own `legal_actions` and `canAct` should follow from the stamp, but check that the AI reads them rather than its own copy.
- The client only renders `canAct` from the view (CLAUDE.md rule 7), so it needs no rule change.

This reverses part of an existing ruling. By CLAUDE.md rule 3 and `spec/README.md` (Adding a ruling):
- Write a new note in this issue's block that supersedes the "may attack at once" half of R783006 and R1041.
- Put its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`.
- Edit R783006's and R1041's text to point to it.

It changes how every Cloaked Unit plays, so it needs a pending patch fragment (`cargo jackioh patches … --rule`) with a hand-written player note (`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`). `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` must agree with that fragment.

### Acceptance

- A new ruling note in this issue's block, with a proving test named after it in `crates/engine/tests/rules/cloaked.rs`. The test covers a Cloaked Unit set on turn N and revealed on turn N+1 (or later) by its controller:
  - it cannot attack that turn, and `legal_actions` offers no attack by it;
  - the reducer refuses an attack it declares;
  - its view shows it cannot act (`canAct` false for attacking);
  - it can switch to Defense;
  - it can attack on its controller's next turn.
- The same test, or a sibling: the revealed Unit with Rush can attack an enemy Unit but not the hero on its reveal turn; with Charge, it can attack the hero too.
- A Unit revealed on the same turn it was set is still sick, as before.
- `r783006_a_unit_reveals_cries_with_a_prompt_and_attacks_next_turn` and any other test that asserts the old attack-at-once behavior are updated to the new rule. None is deleted, skipped or `#[ignore]`d.
- Each Cloaked Unit's own script tests (`crates/cards/src/scripts/**`) that assert an attack on the reveal turn are updated to match.
- The AI does not plan an attack by a Unit it reveals this turn unless that Unit has Rush or Charge. This needs an AI test, in `crates/ai/tests/` or the AI's existing Cloaked tests.
- Spec text is consistent: the §6.1 Cloaked row, R783006 and R1041 no longer say a revealed Unit may attack at once, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` pass. The golden replay and fuzz gates are green; if the golden fixture's fold changes, it is updated in the same PR.

### Blocked by, part of

None.
```
